# System Email Surface image fixture

This message tests a vertical sequence of two locally embedded PNGs in the existing System Email Surface grammar.

## Review points

- Confirm both figure sizes feel proportionate to the message and their order is preserved.
- Inspect the image in light and dark presentation.
- Confirm the caption remains visually connected to the figure.
- Inspect the plain-text alternative and blocked-image behavior.

The paragraph after the figure should remain visually distinct when the message is forwarded, replied to, printed, or exported.
